description: Recorded TinyFish web-agent observations of mcxindia.com, replayed by src/agent_verification.py and compared against data/processed/historical_gold_futures.csv. Agent runs take minutes and cost credits, so results are recorded rather than re-run on every page load.

runs.label: Valid trading day is served correctly
runs.note: Agent set the Date Wise date field to 17/11/2026 and the results table returned 17 Nov 2026. Requested and served dates agree.

runs.label: Market holiday is silently substituted
runs.note: 02 Oct 2026 was Mahatma Gandhi Jayanti, a full MCX trading holiday. The page returned 17 Nov 2026 data while the date input still read 02/10/2026, and showed no message about the substitution. This is the failure mode the problem statement warns about, and a downloaded file cannot detect it.

runs.label: GOLDM December expiry re-read from the live page
runs.note: Read via the Commodity Wise tab (Instrument FUTCOM, Symbol GOLDM, 17/11/2026, nearest expiry). The Date Wise tab paginates across ~1164 pages with no symbol filter, so the agent located the Commodity Wise path on its own.
